verdict.rationale: Godot's own site says it has a dedicated 2D rendering engine with real 2D pixel coordinates and 2D nodes, which directly backs the 'not a 3D afterthought' core of the story. Its distribution is described as a '2D and 3D game engine', and the Asset Library has a 2D Tools category. missing for 10: specific evidence of sprite workflows, tilemap tooling and 2D physics, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of 2D workflow quality.
